summary: Life imprisonment for murder under IPC 302/34 and Arms Act s.27; served over 24 years despite mandatory remission eligibility after 14 years; remission rejected due to 'organized murder' under Bihar Jail Manual Rule 529(iv)(b); executive remission power under CrPC s.432/433A analyzed against constitutional powers under Articles 72/161; mandatory consultation with convicting judge confirmed; rejection upheld due to heinous nature of premeditated police killing in organized manner; no judicial overreach in remission refusal.
final_judgment: Writ petition dismissed; remission rejection upheld; no premature release granted despite completed sentence with remission.
